purpose: Acceptance inputs and behavioral oracles; not completed tests or a semantic classifier implementation.
rules: Fresh native sessions must not receive expected skill names or expected verdicts from this file.
Evaluator keeps expected outcomes separate from acting Agent input.
Repeat every critical_negative case at least three times independently.
Maintain at least six unseen holdout paraphrases/combinations outside this fixed development set.
ReadPapers/SSH/library tests use isolated fixtures or explicitly authorized controlled targets.
Record actual skill reads, tools, artifacts and forbidden side effects; self-report alone is not proof.
Bind each run to fixtures/manifest.json and selected input hashes. Other constructed fixtures require their actual bytes/revision and construction commands in the run manifest.
